summary:
Docs area for founders and partners, committed as 594dc9d on top of the lead's dfd8c19. This worktree's branch had been cut from main (1403f83), so I fast-forwarded it to feat/prototype before starting.

1. README.md (rewritten). Covers what Luma.Green is: a chain diagram and a roles table. Then features by role (households, kabadiwalas, yards and recyclers, manufacturers, Saathis, admin) and a table of public pages. The "See it" gallery lists exactly the 34 files the script produces, as HTML img tags in phone/desktop tables grouped by role, with the first group open. After that: the demo logins table (phone, who, what to try; code 123456, dev only, admin on request), local setup, commands, stack, a docs map, and a status section saying what is real and what is sample data.

2. docs/testing/README.md (new). The A-to-Z test plan: flows A to U plus Z (reset), and a Screenshots section. Each flow gives the role, the login, the start URL, and numbered steps with the expected result.
   - Expected amounts are computed from convex/lib/demo.ts, for example ₹237, ₹314.28 by UPI with 31 points, ₹341.25, ₹1,750 and ₹325,000.
   - Button and tab labels were checked against the other areas' in-progress messages/en.json files and the admin verification components.
   - It ends with a results table testers can copy.

3. docs/product/features.md (new). Three lists: what's built (with URLs), what's sample data, and what's next (from docs/delivery/roadmap.md).

4. scripts/screenshots.mts plus scripts/screenshot-plan.ts, and one line in package.json: "screenshots": "jiti scripts/screenshots.mts".
   - The script checks the app is reachable at BASE_URL (default http://localhost:3100); ONLY=a,b takes just those screens.
   - It signs in through /login once per demo login, picking English if the language grid appears. Phone sign-in allows 10 requests a minute, so the session is reused for both sizes, with one retry after 65 seconds.
   - It takes 17 screens at 390×844 (2x scale) and 1440×900 into docs/screenshots/, and skips the admin.
   - Pages load in a light colour scheme with the Next.js dev badge hidden. Before each picture it waits for network idle, loading skeletons (aria-busy) and fonts, then a short settle.
   - It fails a screen that returns an error or redirects elsewhere, logs it and carries on, then exits with code 1 and a list of what wasn't taken.
   - The weigh-and-pay picture opens /app/requests?tab=today and follows the first "Weigh and pay" link, so it shows the real weighing screen rather than a new request.

5. src/docs.test.ts (new, 13 tests).
   - The screenshot plan: unique kebab-case names, and each screen is a public route or a route in that login's menu. It uses only seeded demo phones, with one sign-in per login, and ONLY and BASE_URL parse correctly.
   - The docs: the README's gallery equals the script's file list, the README and test plan list every demo phone, and every relative link and #anchor in the three docs resolves. I broke one anchor on purpose to confirm that check fails.

checks.lint: pass: pnpm exec eslint on scripts/screenshots.mts, scripts/screenshot-plan.ts and src/docs.test.ts has 0 findings. One scoped single-line disable (sonarjs/no-networkidle-wait) in settle(), with a reason: the brief asks for a network-idle wait, and it is a best-effort readiness wait with a timeout, not a test assertion. Prettier --check is clean on every touched file.
checks.tests: pass: src/docs.test.ts 13/13. Full suite: 25 of 26 files pass; the only failing file is src/i18n/messages.test.ts (22 cases), the one the brief says to ignore until translations land.

unfinished: The screenshots haven't been taken, as instructed, so the README gallery shows 34 missing images until someone runs `pnpm screenshots` and commits docs/screenshots/*.png. To run it: reset the data, start `pnpm dev --port 3100`, and if sign-in fails there, `npx convex env set EXTRA_TRUSTED_ORIGINS http://localhost:3100`. Install Chromium once with `pnpm exec playwright install chromium`.

Flows O (admin prices, /admin/prices) and P (admin support, /admin/support) follow the spec only: the admin worktree hadn't built those screens yet, so their wording and fields need checking after merge.
The test plan's labels match the other areas' in-progress copy as it stood while I wrote it. Walk the plan once after merging and fix any wording that changed.
mergeNotes: Base: every worktree branch (012-1 to 012-8) was cut from main at 1403f83, not from feat/prototype. I fast-forwarded this one to dfd8c19 before working; the siblings appear to have done the same, but confirm each branch's base when merging.
package.json: one line added after `auth:schema` (`"screenshots": "jiti scripts/screenshots.mts"`). If another area touched the scripts block, the conflict will be trivial.

The weigh-and-pay screenshot depends on the shop area's URLs: the `?tab=today` query and `requestHref(id, 'weigh')` producing `/app/requests/{id}#weigh`, as seen in worktree 012-2. If either changes, update the `kabadiwala-weigh-and-pay` entry in scripts/screenshot-plan.ts.

src/docs.test.ts fails on purpose when the docs drift from the code. It watches NAV (src/components/app/nav.ts), publicRoutes (src/i18n/paths.ts), DEMO_ACCOUNTS (convex/lib/demo.ts), the README gallery, and the headings the three docs link to (for example 'The admin' in docs/architecture/auth.md and 'Rules' in docs/product/household.md). It lives in src/ because Vitest only collects src/ and convex/.

Existing docs disagree with the prototype; I left them alone because they belong to other areas. docs/product/household.md gives the tracking URL as /b/{code}, but the app uses /t/{token}. docs/architecture/urls.md and frontend.md plan /app/{org}/…, but the prototype uses /app/…. The admin console-shell nav still marks Verification and Prices as 'Soon'.

Things I did not run: npx convex dev/deploy/run, pnpm dev/build/e2e, and the screenshot script itself. To check the script loads, I imported the plan module, convex/lib/demo.ts and @playwright/test through jiti's API. That confirmed 34 planned files and 5 sign-ins.
Cleanup: you asked for each worktree to be deleted after merging. This one holds node_modules and a non-secret .env.local, so remove it with `git worktree remove --force` once merged.
